title: Aitchison Committee On Public Services
definition: The Public Service Commission appointed in 1886 under the chairmanship of Sir Charles Aitchison to consider the claims of Indians to higher employment in the public services of India.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial microtopic under Modern Indian History (Evolution of Administrative Services) frequently tested in Prelims regarding administrative reforms, colonial policy shifts, and the nomenclature of civil services.
learningOutcomes: Master the historical context, terms of reference, and recommendations of the Aitchison Committee.
Understand the transition from covenanted to provincial/imperial/subordinate civil service classifications.
Analyze the colonial intent behind the committee's reforms and Indian nationalist reactions.
prerequisites: Charter Act of 1853 (End of company patronage)
